paite: Tang a pan Mosi ahong paisuk pah louh mite'n atheih un, mite Aaron kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, akiang ah, "Kisa in, ka ma ua pai ding, pathiante hon bawlsak in. Hiai Mosi, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhepa lah, bang chita ahia, ka thei ngal kei ua," achi uhi.
heading: Dangka-eng Bawngnou Lim / (Diu 9.6-29)

paite: Aaron in akiang uah, "Na zite uh bil a om, na tapate uh bil a om, na tanute uh bil a om, dangka-eng bilbahte tolkhia unla, ka kiang ah hon tawi un,” achi hi.
Mi tengteng in abil ua dangka-eng bilbahte atolkhia ua, Aaron kiang ah ahon tawi uhi.

Ama'n akhut ua pan huaite ala a, sunthoh bawngnou lim abawl a, huai bang in dangka-eng bawngnou lim in asung hi. Huai khit in amau, "Israel aw, Aigupta gam a pan nang hon pikhia na pathian hiai ahi,” akichi uhi.
Aaron in huai amuhtak in, ama uah maitam abawl a, Aaron in thupuan anei a, "Zingchiang TOUPA a dia ankuangluina ahi," achi hi.
Azing in beltak in athou ua, halmang thillat alan ua, lemna thillat atawi uhi. Mite ne ding leh dawn ding in atu ua, kimawl ding in adingh uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Kumsuk in, na mi Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiakte, akihihsiat ziak un.

Amau ka lampi hilh a pan apial pah man hial uhi. Bawngnou lim sun akibawl ua, huai abia ua, amai ah thillatte alan ua, 'Israel aw, hiai na pathian, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhetu ahi,' achi uh," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai mite ka muta a, ngai in, migenhakte ahi uhi.
Huaiziak in tu in atung uah ka thangpaihna akuangzak a, amaute ka kattum theihna ding in hon subuai kei in. Huchi in nam thupi in ka hon bawl ding," achi hi.
Mosi in TOUPA a Pathian angen a, "TOUPA, thilhihtheihna thupi leh ban thahat a Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiaksa, na mite tung ah bangziak a na thangpaihna kuangzak ding ahia?

Bang ding in ahia Aiguptate'n thu gen a, 'Hihse dia amau pikhia ahita ve, tangte a amaute that ding leh leitung maikaih a pan amaute kangtum ding in?' Na thangpaihna thupi lakik inla, na mite tung a hiai thil hoih lou na ngaihtuah kikhelsak in.

Akiang ua, 'Van a aksite bang in na suante ka pungsak dia, na suante kiang a thu ka gensa, hiai gam tengteng ka hon pe ding, huchi in tangtawn in na luah ding uh,' chi a, nangmah ngei a na kichiamna, na sikhate, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob theigige in," achi hi.
Huchi in amite tung a thil hoih lou hih dia angaihtuah TOUPA'N akikhelsakta hi.
Mosi akihei a, tang a kipan apaisuk hi. Akhut ah theihpihna suangpek nihte a-om a, suangpekte alangnih tuak a gelh ahi a, khat lam leh langkhat lam a gelh ahi uhi.
Suangpekte Pathian thilhih ahi a, agelhte leng Pathian gelh ahi, suangpekte tung a kigelhte.
Joshua in mite kikou husa azak in Mosi kiang ah, "Giahphual ah kidouna husa a-om," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Tungnun kituh a kikoute aw ahi kei a, nuaisiah a om ziak a kapte aw leng ahi kei. Lasate husa ahi zaw ka zak," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, giahphual kiang ahong tuntak in, bawngnou leh lam amuta hi. Huchi in Mosi hehna asou a, akhut a pan suangpekte apai a, tang nuai ah akeksakta hi.
Abawngnou bawl uh ala a, mei ah akhul a, agawinen a, tui tung ah atheh a, Israel suante adawnsak hi.
Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Hiai mite'n bang ahia na kiang a ahih uh, atung ua hichi tel a khelhna thupi na tunsak?" achi hi.
Aaron in, "Mite'n thil sia azondan uh na thei hi, ka toupa' hehna kuang kei hen.
Ka ma ua pai ding, pathiante hon bawlsak in. Hiai Mosi, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhetoupa lah, bang suakta ahia ka thei ngal kei ua, ka kiang a achih ziak un.
Ke'n akiang uah, dangka-eng nei peuh in hon tolkhia un ka chi hi. Huchi in amau kei ahon pia ua; ke'n mei sung ah ka khia a, hiai bawngnou lim ahong pawtkhia," achi hi.
Aaron in a-utut ua om dia mite ataizak uh phal in, melmate ma ah zahlak in a-omsak, chih Mosi in amu hi.
Giahphual kongpi ah Mosi adingh a, "TOUPA lam a pang kuakua ahia? Ka kiang ah hong pai hen," achi hi. Akiang ah Levi ta tengteng akikhawmkhawmta uhi.

Ama'n akiang uah, "Israel TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: Michih in apang ah anamsau kuah henla, giahphual tuansuak in kongpi khat a pan kongpi dang ah lut in pawt henla, michih in asanggampa, michih in alawmpa, michih in a-invengte that hen," achi hi.
Levi tapate'n Mosi thu dungzui in ahihta ua; huchi in huai ni in mite lak ah mi sangthum asi uhi.
Mosi in, "Michih in atapa, michih in a-unaupa douta na hih ziak un, ahon vualzawl theihna ding in tuni in TOUPA a ding in kihihsiangthou un," achi hi.
Azing in hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in mite kiang ah, "Khelhna khawktak in na khialta uhi. Tu in TOUPA kiang ah ka hohtou dia; na khelhna uh a ding in lemna ka bawl thei maithei hi," achi hi.
TOUPA kiang ah Mosi akik nawn a, "Aw, hiai mite'n khelhna thupitak ahih ua, dangka-eng pathiante akibawl uhi.
Ahi a lah, tu in, akhelhna uh ngaidam in; Na ngaihdam kei dingleh, na gelhsa na laibu a pan kei hon thaimang in, ka hon ngen ahi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Kuapeuh ka tung a khial, ka laibu a pan ka thaimang ding.
Huaiziak in tu in kuan inla, na kiang a ka genna mun ah mite pi in. Ngai in, na ma ah ka Angel apai ding. Akoi abang hitaleh gawt dia ka veh ni in akhelhna uh ziak in amaute ka gawt ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Aaron in abawl bawngnou mai a thil alat ziak in TOUPA'N mite hipi in agawtta hi.
